instrumentCaveat: Chromium device emulation on a desktop GPU, headless. Layout, touch input, reachability, target size and control collision are REAL and transfer to a handset. The frame rate is an UPPER BOUND no physical phone will reach. iOS/Safari is not covered at all (Playwright webkit has no WebGPU), nor is a real Bluetooth pad, thermal throttle, cellular network or notch safe-area inset. Those five rows are docs/MOBILE_PHONE_CHECKLIST.md, for the owner.
